findings.issue: Roster titles are loaded unchanged, while catalog and chart titles are canonicalized through `alias_of`. Consequently, a roster using an aliased spelling never matches the canonical finish-order title and incorrectly scores zero; it is also shown as missing in player detail.
findings.suggestion: Canonicalize every ranked and dark-horse title in each loaded Group after overrides are available, or consistently canonicalize titles at every scoring and rendering comparison.

findings.issue: The claimed Final-state precedence is not implemented. After `window_end + 1`, zero-gross films with analyst estimates remain `pre_release` and retain speculative projections, and the normal projection-count gate still decides whether to simulate. Final output therefore does not reliably collapse projections to frozen actual grosses as required by §10.1.
findings.suggestion: Handle the Final state explicitly before forecast gating: project every film from its frozen cumulative in-window gross with zero uncertainty and run/render the final standings independently of the Early/Live projection policy.

findings.issue: A production build renders `history.html` from the existing forecast-history file, then appends the current simulation at line 159. The published history page therefore always lags one refresh and remains locked on the first successful production forecast even though that refresh was recorded.
findings.suggestion: Append or merge the current production forecast before building history data, while preserving local mode and same-date last-write-wins behavior.

findings.issue: Simulation crashes for a Group with no players because `score_matrix.max(axis=0)` reduces an empty dimension. A forecastable catalog can reach this path, violating the day-zero requirement that an empty roster render an empty section rather than raise.
findings.suggestion: Return an empty SimResult for an empty Group, or bypass simulation while still rendering empty forecast views.

findings.issue: Player names from forecast history are interpolated directly into SVG text, and the resulting SVG is marked safe by the caller. A crafted player value containing markup can therefore inject active HTML/script into `history.html`, bypassing Jinja autoescaping.
findings.suggestion: XML-escape all dynamic SVG text and attribute values before concatenation, or construct the SVG through an autoescaped template instead of marking an unescaped string as safe.
